APPROVE
The extracted helpers preserve evaluation order (job grants are added eagerly while `inheriting` is filled, and the lazy top-level iterator runs only after the loop finishes), they cut the original method's nested branches down to an estimated complexity of about 11, and the code appears to type-check — though I couldn't find the repository here to build it, so I couldn't confirm that `WorkflowJobs` yields `List<(int Index, string Line)>` bodies.
